title: Figures 3–4. Graphene quantum dot energy diagram and charge stability color plots
description: Figure 3 pairs an energy diagram (E vs. r, showing a potential well of depth U0 and gap 2Δ between -R and R) with a plot of bound state levels E/Δ versus dot radius R[ħv/Δ]. Figure 4 shows two color-scale plots: (a) transconductance at Vsd = 50 μV versus gate voltages Vg1 and Vg2 in mV with labeled honeycomb charge regions, and (b) one vertex of the honeycomb at Vsd = 800 μV. Caption reads in part "Charge stability diagrams for series-coupled quantum dots."
